decisionText: Approve ADR 0015 as the M2 validation profile with its stated command, isolation and resource limits. Defer authorization to execute the experiment until separate approval of the exact reviewed workstream corpus, frozen base and image digest.

authorized: Use the accepted profile to prepare and review a real-workstream corpus.
Maintain the read-only, non-authorizing Git preflight.
deferredInputs: Two or three actual reviewed PR URLs and their immutable source commits.
One frozen develop base commit and declared workstream footprints.
The exact container image digest and dependency set.
prohibitedUntilSeparateDecision: Implementing or running the repository-code container command stage.
Executing the real-workload experiment or promoting any repository ref.
Treating this approval as a positive scientific result, runtime admission or M2 closure.
